build: The unmodified pinned CPU was compiled by the repository conformance recipe with GGML_CPU_GENERIC, -ffp-contract=off and one worker.
reference: Use the frozen VT-180 rows and the original GGML decode traits. Cycle across 25 left formats with index (right_index + 7*operation) mod 25 for all 29 right formats and four operations. Tile left halves using source row (row + row/4 + row/8 + half) mod 2, with integer division, and reverse the two right rows. Run ggml_repeat on the right followed by the appropriate original F32 binary graph. Encode each complete output row with the original CPU callback or ggml_quantize_chunk with uniform importance when required.
